keyword: order diesel 120 twin engine concrete pump

title.en: The Diesel 120 Order Quotes Two 145 kW Engines
title.zh: 柴油120的订单要报两台 145 kW 发动机

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 120 as 290 kW from two 145 kW diesels, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa and 150 m / 500 m. The inquiry has to say two units.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120印成两台 145 kW 柴油机合计 290 kW、100 m³/h、40 MPa、150 m / 500 m。询盘必须写明两台。

h1.en: Write “Two Engines” on the Diesel 120 Purchase
h1.zh: 在柴油120的采购上写“两台发动机”

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 120 as engine power 290 kW (two units of 145 kW), theoretical output 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, 150 m / 500 m, Kawasaki 112 (two units), aggregate 6 cm and below, 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm and 8000 kg. An order that says 145 kW once has dropped a printed unit. An order that says 120 m³/h has replaced the output cell. Send the twin-engine line and the path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油120印成发动机功率 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、理论输送量 100 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.6 m³、150 m / 500 m、川崎 112（两台）、骨料 6 cm 及以下、7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm、8000 kg。只写一次 145 kW 的订单丢掉了印出的一台。写成 120 m³/h 的订单替换了输送量格。把双机这一行和路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印价格。

body.en: The hydraulic pump line also says two units. Diesel 40 prints one Kawasaki 112. Do not shorten Diesel 120 to that single line.
body.zh: 液压泵一行也写两台。柴油40印一台川崎 112。不要把柴油120缩成那一行。

heading.en: 8000 kg is the heaviest weight in this set
heading.zh: 8000 kg 是这一组里最重的重量

body.en: Use it on the transport note with 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. It is not a price.
body.zh: 把它和 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm 一起写进运输说明。它不是价格。

body.en: Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m on a 110 kW motor. 40 MPa appears on both pages and does not merge them.
body.zh: 电动80在 110 kW 电机上印 60 m³/h 和 900 m / 300 m。两页都出现 40 MPa，这并不能把它们合并。

alt.en: Diesel 120 concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a Xingtai concrete pump manufacturer
alt.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
